comments.author: fehiepsi
comments.body:
Could you try to use
```
jit_update = jax.jit(svi.update)
jit_get_params = jax.jit(svi.get_params)
```
instead?

comments.author: jeppejohansen
comments.body: Dios mio! That worked!!! also reduced running time by a factor +1000! Thanks!

comments.author: fehiepsi
comments.body: Glad that it works. In jax, it's recommended to jit the body functions of python loops.
